title: Alien Alphabet Order
commonMistakes: Forgetting the prefix rule when the longer word appears first
Omitting letters that appear only inside words after the first character
Returning an arbitrary topological order rather than the smallest one
Adding duplicate edges and corrupting indegree counts
followUps: How can you tell whether the recovered alphabet is unique?
What should happen if the words contain uppercase letters?
How would the problem change if the list were only partially sorted?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
